senses.gloss: m.(h. אַפֶּדֶן , Pers.; v. Friedr. Del. Proleg. p. 149, note) country-seat, mansion, palace.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 43:10">Targ. Jer. XLIII, 10</cite> (h. text <he>שפריר</he>).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 62a:7">Keth. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>גני בטולא דא׳</he> sleeps in the shade of his palace (at home, in safety).—Pl. <he>אַפַּדְנֵי</he>.
